1973-ahsme-11.q:
A circle with a circumscribed and an inscribed square centered at the origin $O$ of a rectangular coordinate system with positive $x$ and $y$ axes $OX$ and $OY$ is shown in each figure I to IV below.

![figure](/amc/fig/1973-ahsme/11-1.png)

The inequalities

$$
|x|+|y|\leq\sqrt{2(x^{2}+y^{2})}\leq 2\,\text{Max}(|x|, |y|)
$$

are represented geometrically\* by the figure numbered

\* An inequality of the form $f(x, y) \leq g(x, y)$, for all $x$ and $y$, is represented geometrically by a figure showing the containment $\{\text{the set of points }(x, y)\text{ such that }g(x, y) \leq a\} \subset \{\text{the set of points }(x, y)\text{ such that }f(x, y) \leq a\}$ for a typical real number $a$.
